rounds.title_zh: 镜面金属与哑光混合不再在前 10% 进度内瞬间糊散：对数空间几何粗糙度插值选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Material blending without midpoint mirror collapse: Perceptual log-space geometric roughness interpolation selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在跨越镜面金属（α₀=0.0100）至白垩哑光（α₁=1.0000）的 17 个混合站点（u ∈ [0.0000, 1.0000]）上，朴素算术线性 α 插值在第 4 站（u=0.25）跳变至 α=0.2575（感知粗糙度 G=0.7054，超冲 +182.15%），在第 8 站中点（u=0.50）跳变至 α=0.5050（感知粗糙度 G=0.8516，超冲 +70.31%，污染全部 15/17 个内部过渡站）。
采用对数空间几何均值粗糙度插值 α_log(u) = α₀^(1−u)·α₁^u = 0.01^(1−u)，在第 4 站锁死 α=0.0316（G=0.2500），在第 8 站中点锁死精确几何均值 α=√(0.01·1.00)=0.1000（G=0.5000），在全 17 站恒定保持单位感知斜率 dG/du = 1.0000（0/17 畸变站）。
58 实体 17 站点感知光泽倍频台对比闭式对数几何插值与 64 步乘法李群指数 ODE 积分基线（8192 次 5.16 ms vs 12.23 ms，提速 2.37×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经材质生成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 blend stations (u ∈ [0.0000, 1.0000]) from mirror chrome (α₀=0.0100) to matte chalk (α₁=1.0000), naive linear α interpolation jumps to α=0.2575 (perceptual G=0.7054, +182.15% overshoot) at station 4 (u=0.25) and α=0.5050 (G=0.8516, +70.31% overshoot) at midpoint station 8 (u=0.50), warping all 15/17 interior stations.

Log-space geometric roughness interpolation α_log(u) = α₀^(1−u)·α₁^u locks station 4 at α=0.0316 (G=0.2500) and midpoint station 8 at exact geometric mean α=0.1000 (G=0.5000) with constant unit perceptual slope dG/du = 1.0000 and 0/17 warped stations.

The 58-solid 17-station perceptual gloss octave bench compares closed-form evaluation against 64-step multiplicative Lie-group ODE integration (5.16 ms vs 12.23 ms at 8,192 passes, 2.37× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural material synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 皮肤与体积云次表面包裹参数越调大越过曝发白？Green 平方分母能量守恒包裹选型 FAQ

conclusions_zh: 在跨越 17 个包裹宽度站点（w ∈ [0.0000, 1.0000]）上，朴素一次分母包裹 max(0, μ+w)/(1+w) 死守顶点 1.0 而将受光球冠底边拉宽 (1+w) 倍，使球面总能量按 E = 1+w 在第 4 站（w=0.25）膨胀至 1.2500×、第 8 站（w=0.50）膨胀至 1.5000×、第 16 站（w=1.00）膨胀至 2.0000×（污染 16/17 个站点）。
采用 Simon Green (GPU Gems 2004) 平方分母能量守恒包裹 max(0, μ+w)/(1+w)²，使顶点按 1/(1+w) 成比例让出能量（w=0.50 顶点 0.6667、w=1.00 顶点 0.5000），在全 17 站恒定锁死球面总积分能量 E = 1.0000×（0/17 过曝站）。

Simon Green (GPU Gems 2004) quadratic wrap normalization max(0, μ+w)/(1+w)² attenuates apex radiance as 1/(1+w) (0.6667 at w=0.50, 0.5000 at w=1.00) to lock total spherical energy at E = 1.0000× across all 17 stations with 0/17 overbright stations.

The 58-solid 17-station subsurface wrap calorimeter bench compares closed-form evaluation against 64-ring spherical zonal quadrature (0.73 ms vs 11.60 ms at 8,192 passes, 15.90× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural relighting.

rounds.title_zh: 程序化地形与运镜不再印出网格马赫带折痕与急动：Perlin 五次 C² 平滑阶跃选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Procedural noise without grid Mach-band creases: Perlin C² quintic smoothstep selection FAQ

Ken Perlin (SIGGRAPH 2002) C² quintic smoothstep 6u⁵−15u⁴+10u³ locks S₅″(0) = S₅″(1) = 0.0000 (ΔS″ = 0.0000) and smoothly ramps curvature to +5.6250 at u=0.25 with 0/17 creased stations.

The 58-solid 17-station C² curvature continuity bench compares 3-FMA Horner evaluation against 64-substep Regularized Incomplete Beta I_u(3,3) quadrature (0.36 ms vs 27.75 ms at 8,192 passes, 77.69× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural terrain synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 360° 环境反射不再在背面拧成菊花星芒奇点：Heidrich-Seidel 双抛物面保角映射选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: HDR 高光经过 L/(1+L) 后总像蒙着一层水泥灰？Reinhard 扩展白点有理映射选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: HDR tone reproduction without a muddy grey highlight ceiling: Reinhard extended white-point rational mapping selection FAQ

58 实体 17 站点色调映射感光台对比闭式有理算子与 64 子步 Weber-Fechner 对比度 ODE 积分基线（8192 次 0.43 ms vs 39.93 ms，提速 92.08×，误差 < 2e-11），不冒充神经 HDR 逆色调映射。
conclusions_en: Across 17 HDR luminance stations (L ∈ [0.0000, 4.0000], scene white point L_white=4.0000), naive simple Reinhard L/(1+L) drops to 0.6667 at L=2.0 and stalls at 0.8000 at L_white=4.0, starving the top 20.00% of display brightness across 16/17 stations.

Reinhard et al. (SIGGRAPH 2002 Eq. 4) extended white-point operator L(1+L/L_white²)/(1+L) locks L=2.0 at 0.7500, L=3.0 at 0.8906, and L_white=4.0 at exact full display white 1.0000 with 0/17 starved stations.

The 58-solid 17-station Reinhard sensitometer bench compares closed-form evaluation against 64-substep Weber-Fechner contrast ODE integration (0.43 ms vs 39.93 ms at 8,192 passes, 92.08× speedup, <2e-11 error) without claiming neural inverse tone mapping.

rounds.title_zh: 金属高光不再像贴了孤立白点的塑料球：Walter GGX 柯西-洛伦兹长尾微表面分布选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Metallic specular highlights without plastic halo collapse: Walter GGX Cauchy-Lorentz long-tailed NDF selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在跨越 17 个归一化微表面斜率站点（s = tan θ_h / α ∈ [0.0000, 4.0000]）上，Cook-Torrance Beckmann 高斯分布 exp(−s²/2) 在第 8 站（2α）跌至 0.1353，在第 12 站（3α）暴跌至 0.0111（NDF 强度暗 81.03×），在第 16 站（4α）跌至 0.0003（污染全部 10/17 个外围光晕站）。

58 实体 17 站点微表面测角光度台对比闭式有理 GGX 与 64 子步洛伦兹微分衰减 ODE 积分基线（8192 次 0.31 ms vs 27.48 ms，提速 90.03×，误差 < 1e-8），不冒充神经材质生成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 normalized microfacet slope stations (s = tan θ_h / α ∈ [0.0000, 4.0000]), Cook-Torrance Beckmann Gaussian exp(−s²/2) collapses to 0.1353 at 2α, 0.0111 (81.03× dimmer NDF) at 3α, and 0.0003 at 4α across 10/17 outer halo stations.
Walter et al. (EGSR 2007) & Disney GGX Cauchy-Lorentz envelope 1/(1+s²) preserves 0.2000 at 2α, 0.1000 at 3α, and 0.0588 at 4α with 0/17 halo-starved stations and zero exp() calls.

rounds.title_en: Dielectric surfaces without a 200% glowing grazing rim: Ashikhmin-Shirley subtractive Fresnel-diffuse transmittance selection FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 车灯与掠射水面高光不再在 45° 处被一刀切平：Blinn 半角向量微平面反射定律选型 FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 单法线构造切标架不再在极点炸出 0/0=NaN 黑斑：Pixar-Frisvad 无分支有理正交基选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Tangent frames without pole collapse or square roots: Pixar-Frisvad branchless rational orthonormal basis selection FAQ

rounds.title_zh: 粗糙金属边缘因 G₁(V)·G₁(L) 独立相乘而平白发黑？Heitz 高度相关联合可见度选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Rough microfacet metals without double-shadowing darkening: Heitz height-correlated Smith G₂ selection FAQ

Eric Heitz (JCGT 2014) height-correlated Smith G₂_corr = 1/(1+2Λ) locks Λ=1.0 at 0.3333, Λ=1.5 at 0.2500, and Λ=2.0 at 0.2000 with 0/17 over-darkened stations.

The 58-solid 17-station Height-Correlated Smith G₂ bench compares closed-form evaluation against 64-slab microfacet height-CDF quantile integration (0.32 ms vs 152.99 ms at 8,192 passes, 484.14× speedup, <1e-13 error) without claiming neural material synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 树枝随风摇摆与刚体旋转不再越转越长：Rodrigues 轴角李群等距旋转定律选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Vertex wind sway and rigid rotation without rubber-band stretching: Rodrigues SO(3) axis-angle rotation selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在跨越 17 个旋转弧度站点（θ ∈ [0.0000, 1.5000] rad）上，朴素一阶切向叉乘 v₀ + θ(k×v₀) 缺失向心回拉项，使长度按勾股斜边 √(1+θ²) 在第 8 站（θ=0.75 rad）拉长至 1.2500×、第 12 站（θ=1.125 rad）拉长至 1.5052×、第 16 站（θ=1.50 rad）暴涨至 1.8028×（污染 16/17 个站点）。
采用 Olinde Rodrigues (1840) 轴角旋转公式 v₀ cos θ + (k×v₀) sin θ + k(k·v₀)(1−cos θ)，在全 17 站恒定锁死欧氏长度 ‖v‖ = 1.0000×（0/17 膨胀拉长）。
58 实体 17 站点轴角李群保长旋转台对比闭式 Rodrigues 求值与 64 子步 Cayley-Padé 李群等距积分基线（8192 次 7.72 ms vs 22.27 ms，提速 2.88×，误差 < 1e-13），不冒充神经运动生成。

The 58-solid 17-station Hertz-Boussinesq elastic contact bench compares closed-form evaluation against 64-ring hemispherical pressure quadrature (0.21 ms vs 10.63 ms at 8,192 passes, 50.36× speedup, <1e-12 error) without claiming neural soft-body simulation.
